senses.gloss:
षोदत् m. A young ox with six
teeth.

सोदर a. [समानमुदरं यस्य समानस्य
सः] Born from the same womb,
uterine.
--रः A uterine brother.
--रा A uterine sister.

सोदर्यः A co-uterine brother,
brother of whole blood; (fig. also);
भ्रातुः सोदर्यमात्मानमिंद्रजिद्वधशोभिनः
R. 15. 26; अवज्ञासोदर्यं दारिद्र्यं Dk.

सोद्योग a.
1 Making vigorous
exertions, diligent, active,
persevering, industrious.
--2 Violent,
strong.

सोद्वेग a.
1 Anxious,
apprehensive.
--2 Sorrowful.
--गं ind.
Anxiously, eagerly.
